name: Impossible
description: Good luck getting any of these past the table.

medium: The walrus has revoked my library card.
I owe eleven dollars to a volcano.
My shadow has started arriving late.
The lighthouse and I are no longer speaking.
A pelican notarised the whole thing.
Never trust a staircase that hums.
I was briefly the mayor of a puddle.
The cheese filed a formal complaint.
My left shoe is fluent in Portuguese.
That cloud has been following me since Lisbon.
I traded my bicycle for a rumour.
The xylophone knows what it did.
We buried the trombone at sea.
An otter is contesting my will.
Gravity and I have agreed to disagree.
hard: The ostrich who taught my yoga class was arrested for impersonating a lamp.
I can't come in on Thursday because my trampoline is testifying in court.
According to the map, the treasure is buried under a different, smaller map.
My grandfather once arm-wrestled a lighthouse and they called it a draw.
The submarine was fine until someone opened a window to let the bees out.
I've been legally required to apologise to every pigeon in the city.
Seven accordions fell down the stairs and it was the best concert I've heard.
The wizard at the bus stop said my aura is the wrong shade of rectangle.
We had to cancel the eclipse because nobody remembered to book the moon.
My horoscope just said 'not you' and then listed someone else's name.
